The tweet contains an embedded image, which appears to be a screenshot of a social media post from Donald J. Trump's account. The video then zooms into this embedded image, which shows a pair of gold-colored high-top sneakers on a display stand at a convention. Text on this image reads 'RARE TRUMP SNEAKERS LISTED FOR $180K AT SNEAKER CON IN RIYADH'. A separate text overlay 'wtf...' appears over this second view.
